Master of Science in Informatics

The Department of Computer Science offers a comprehensive two-year Master of Science curriculum designed to prepare graduates for high-impact careers in research and industry.

Degree Program Structure

The program consists of 120 ECTS credit points distributed over 4 semesters:

  • Core Foundations (30 ECTS): Algorithms, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning
  • Elective Modules (40 ECTS): Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Robotics
  • Research Internship & Seminar (20 ECTS)
  • Master's Thesis and Colloquium (30 ECTS)

Admission Requirements

Applicants must have completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline with at least 180 ECTS.

Application deadline for non-EU applicants is 31 May 2026. Domestic applications remain open until 15 July 2026.
